Transport Corporation of India Completes ₹150 Crore Share Buyback
Tipranks - Tipranks - Sat Oct 31, 3:12AM CDT
Transport Corporation of India Limited ( (IN:TCI) ) just unveiled an update.
Transport Corporation of India Limited has completed a share buyback of 1,562,500 fully paid equity shares with a face value of INR 2 each at a price of INR 960 per share, aggregating up to INR 150 crore through the tender offer route. The buyback was conducted on a proportionate basis in compliance with Indian company law and securities regulations, with the tendering period running from October 15 to October 22, 2026.
Following acceptance of all 1,562,500 shares on October 27, 2026, the company issued a post-buyback public announcement on October 28, 2026, which was published in multiple national and regional newspapers for eligible shareholders. This completed disclosure underscores TCI’s adherence to regulatory requirements and signals a capital return strategy that may enhance earnings per share and support its market positioning in the logistics sector.

The communication to stock exchanges confirms formal closure of the buyback process and ensures transparency for investors and market participants. Reduced share count after the buyback can impact ownership structure and potentially strengthen shareholder confidence in the company’s financial management and long-term value creation approach.
More about Transport Corporation of India Limited
Transport Corporation of India Limited operates in the logistics and transportation sector, providing freight movement and related services across India. The company focuses on integrated supply chain solutions and serves a broad base of industrial and commercial customers, positioning itself as a key player in organised transport and logistics services.
Its equity shares are listed on both BSE and the National Stock Exchange of India, giving it access to capital markets and a diverse shareholder base. The company’s activities in corporate actions such as share buybacks reflect an emphasis on capital allocation and shareholder value within the competitive logistics industry.
